tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab mo sngags kyi dri lan sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ blo chen rnams kyi blau gros dang*/ /mthun pa'i dri lan 'debs dka' yang*/ /rang gi blo la gang shar ba/ /de tsam smra la nyes pa ci/ /dri ba dang po'i lan ni/ rjes gnang lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung*/ gzengs bstod rnams dkyil chog spyi la grags pa ltar na/ cho ga de rnams nyid kyi rang ngos nas/ bum dbang nyid kyi cho ga'i yan lag yin dgos te/ bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ dang po'i dbang ni gtso bo ste/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i ming can no/ /gsum pa kun nas sbyor bas ste/ /bzhi pa'i don ni dam pa'o/ /gtso bo'i dbye ba bcu gcig ste/ bcu gnyis pa ni gsang ba'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni yang dag sbyor/ /bcu bzhi pa ni don dam ste/ /zhes chu sogs dbang bcu gcig po bum dbang yin par bshad cing*/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa'i grub thob tsam dang*/ paṇḍi ta tsam gyis bshad pa la/ 'thad mi 'thad kyi dpyad pa gtong du rung yang*/ rgyud rnam dag nas bshad pa la yid ches kho na byed pa las/ gzhan du mi rung bas so/ /des na lung bstan dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod gsum po gsang ba/ shes rab/ bzhi pa gsum gyi mtha' rten du go rim bzhin du sbyor ba 'di la/ dkyil chog rin chen 'bar ba nas bshad pa tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan rgya gar ba'i lung gsal po med/ bod kyi bla chen 'brog mi'i man ngag las ni 'byung ngo*/ /de la man ngag spong du mi rung mod kyi/ de rnams ngo bo'i sgo nas bum dbang gi mtha' rten kho na yin kyang*/ bum dbang ni kun gyi thun mong yin pa'i phyir/ dbang gong ma rnams kyi mtha' rten du sbyor ba'ang mi 'gal te/ dper na grong pa'i sgos g.yog rnams rgyal po'i yang g.yog tu 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /des na lung bstan ni gsang dbang gi cho ga'i yan lag ma yin kyang*/ gsang dbang dag dag byed yin cing*/ lung ston pa yang ngag gi bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ rigs mthun pa'i sgo nas de'i mtha' rten du bla thabs su sbyar nas byed pa sogs gzhan gnyis la'ang rigs 'gre ste/

chos mthun sbyar nas skabs de dang der byed pa tsam yin gyi gzhan du na de dag gong ma gsum gyi yan lag kho na yin na/ kyai rdor man ngag lugs lta bu la/ dbang bzhi nub so sor bskur ba'i tshe bum dbang gi mtha' rten du de rnams sbyor dgos pa/ slob dpon rtse mo'i dbang chu chen mo las gsal bar bshad pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur te gong ma gsum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag de/ bum dbang gi mtha' rten du sbyar na ga la 'thad/ dri ba gnyis pa'i lan ni/ rigs lnga'i dbang bum dbang yin nam min zhes pa 'di la/ rigs lnga zhes pa yin na/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i don du 'gyur ba yin la/ de lta na ni nges pa med cing*/ rigs lnga zhes gsung rgyu yin na/ rig pa'i dbang lngar 'gyur bas/ dus 'khor dang sems 'brel skor gsum lta bu nas gsungs pa'i rnam gzhag rnams bor nas/ gzhan spyi khyab pa'i rnams kyi lugs ltar byas na/ rig pa'i dbang lnga bum dbang nges par yin la/ rig pa'i dbang lngar song ba'i chu cod pan sogs bla med kyi khyad chos yin pa dang*/ spyod rgyud dang rnal 'byor rgyud na yod pa'i chu cod pan rdor dril sogs la rig pa'i dbang gi tha snyad mi 'jog lags/ de'i rgyu mtshan sbyang bya phung po lnga'am rnam shes tshogs brgyad/ sbyong byed rgyal ba rigs lnga'am/ rigs lnga dang dod mtshungs pa'i lha'i rnam gzhag dang sbyor zhing*/ ma rig pa lnga spong*/ rig pa ye shes lnga bskyed ces pa'i sgra bshad dang*/ rig pa'i lha mos dbang bskur ba'i don rnams/ bla med kho na las gzhan de dag la mi tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /des na ye shes thig le las/ chu yi dbang bskur dbu rgyan dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /zhes pa rgyud sde gong ma'i chu cod pan gnyis dang phyogs mtshungs pa'i dbang*/ bya rgyud rang rkang nyid la gsang ba spyi rgyud las gsungs pa ltar/ sngags dang phyag rgya'i dbang du grags pa de gnyis yin la/

rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming*/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /zhes pa ni rnal 'byor phyi nang gnyis kyi dbang la/ rdo rje dril bu'i dbang yod mod/ spyod rgyud la rdor dril nges pa can gyi dbang med kyang*/ rdo rje dril bu gnyis ka phyag mtshan gyi dbang yin pa bzhin du/ rgyud der yang ji ltar 'os pa'i phyag mtshan gyi dbang yod pas/ de dang 'di phyogs mtshungs tsam la dgongs pa yin cing*/ spyir spyod rgyud kyi dbang la/ phyag mtshan dang ming dbang yod pa'i nges pa med de/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ chu dbang dang*/ mig thur dang*/ me long dang*/ chos bshad rnams las ma gsungs cing*/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/ chu cod pan rdo rje ming dbang ste bzhi po gsungs par mkhas pa rnams la grags pa dang*/ ngan song sbyong rgyud lta bu da lta rnal 'byor rgyud kho nar grags la/ bla ma rnams kyis rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral ba yin gyi/ rgyud kyi ngo bo la bltas na spyod rgyud du gsal la/ jo bo rje yang spyod rgyud du bzhed pas/ rgyud 'di las kyang*/ dbang gi dngos gzhi de dag dang*/ gung mthun par 'byung bas na/ spyod rgyud kyi nang mtshan 'ga' zhig la/ rig pa'i dbang lnga'i dod tsam yod par ston pa'o/ /des na spyod rgyud kyi chu sogs dbang lnga dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi de lnga dang*/ bla med kyi rig pa'i dbang lnga la ming mtshungs pa dang*/ dbang rdzas phyogs mthun pa dang*/ rnal 'byor phyi nang gnyis la ni cho ga'i tshig rigs kyang phyogs mtshungs tsam yod kyang*/ don mi 'dra ba shin tu che bas/ bla med kyi dbang bzhi dang zlos par ni mi 'gyur la/ spyir bum dbang tsam ni bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum la yod par brjod kyang mi 'gal te/ bum pas dbang bskur bar yang nas yang du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dbang bzhi'i ya gyal gyi bum dbang ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bum dbang yin pa'i phyir/

de dag la med mod kyang*/ spyir dbang bzhi bla med kyi khyad chos su 'chad pa'i don dbang bzhi po re re nas bla med kho na'i khyad chos yin zhes 'chad mi dgos kyi/ rgyud de dang de las dbang bzhi tshang bar ston pa ni/ bla med kyi khyad chos yin zhes pa'i don no/ /dper na stong nyid bcu drug gi rnam gzhag theg chen gyi khyad chos yin yang*/ stong nyid dang po bzhi nyan thos kyi theg pa nas bshad pa lta bus mtshon no/ /dri ba gsum pa'i lan ni/ phyir mi ldog pa yi ni dbang*/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du gsal bar byas/ /de ni drug gi bye brag dbang*/ /de ni slob dpon dbang zhes bya/ /zhes 'byung bas/ rnal 'byor rgyud la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang*/ nang tshan cho ga'i yan lag gis phye ba'i dbang drug yod par ma zad/ gsang dbang gi ming can zhig kyang yod mod/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bum dbang dang gsang dbang med pa'i phyir/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang bzhi po bla med kyi khyad chos su bshad pa dang mi 'gal lo/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi slob dpon gyi dbang de la/ rgyud de nyid rang gi lugs kyi dam tshig gsum sbyin pa yod kyang*/ spyir bla med kyi dam tshig gsum du khyad che zhing*/ rdor dril gyi dam tshig gnyis phyogs mthun rung tsam yin kyang*/ sgos phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig la khyad par shin tu che'o/ /yang dkyil chog phal che ba'i dbang du byas na/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa slob dpon gyi dbang gi skabs su byed pa mang ba yin yang*/ mtha' gcig tu nges pa med de/ rgya bod gnyis char du mkhas mchog rnams la shin tu grags che ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'am/ 'jig rten snang byed ces bya ba rjes 'brang dang bcas pa las/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa/ slob ma'i dbang du bshad nas/ slob dpon gyi dbang gzhan zhig gsungs so/ /spyir bum dbang thams cad la slob dpon gyi dbang du bshad pa yang yod de/

gong du drangs pa/ gtso bo'i dbye ba bcu gcig ces pa'i gtso bo ni slob dpon gyi ming yin pa'i phyir dang*/ brtag gnyis kyi dngos bstan sgra ji bzhin pa yang*/ bum dbang thams cad la slob dpon gyi dbang du ming 'dogs par dgongs so/ /dri ba bzhi pa'i lan ni/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun gyi 'bras bu mthar thug 'og min gyi rig 'dzin yin pa dang*/ dbang bdun gyi 'bras bu sa bdun du bshad pa mi 'gal lam zhes pa dang*/ de las 'phros pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sa bdun la sbyor na'ang*/ de sbyor lam yin na/ dbangabadun gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'bras bur mi 'gyur/ zhes pa 'di la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sa bdun la sbyor ba'i gsal kha ni med mod/ 'phags lam gyi sa bdun la sbyor phyin/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sa la'ang don gyis 'byor te/ de gnyis 'gros mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang sa bdun dbang bdun gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'bras bur yang ma bshad la/ dngos 'bras su yang mi byed do/ /'o na ci zhe na/ dbang bdun bskur bas ma 'ongs pa na 'phags pa'i sa bdun po de dag thob par 'gyur nges pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa ste/ 'di skabs kyi ma 'ongs pa yang rgya yan la mi 'jog gi dam tshig ye ma nyams pa'i dbang du byas nas/ spyir btang la gnas skabs de'i skye ba phyi ma'i mtha' tshun chod la'o/ /des na sa bcu gnyis thob pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa la dbang bcu gcig gam/ bcu gnyis bskur ba yin zhing*/ 'on kyang lam bsgoms pas sa thob pa yin gyi/ dbang de dang de'i dngos 'bras las/ thob ces kyang mi brjod la/ dbang bdun gyi sa bdun thob pa'i rten 'brel 'grig par byed kyang*/ sa bdun thob pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig byed la dbang bdun dgos pas khyab pa'ang ma yin no/ /des na rten 'brel bsgrigs pa tsam gyi sgo nas ma 'ongs pa na thob par 'gyur ba'i 'bras bu'i dbang du byas na/

dbang bdun gyi 'bras bu mthar thug kyang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rdo rje bzhi yin la/ dbang bdun gyi dbang don nam/ dbang de'i lam bskyed rim gyi dngos 'bras mtho shos/ 'og min gyi rig pa 'dzin pa yin par bshad kyi de las mtho ba ma yin no/ /des na dbang bskur bdun po rang gi dngos 'bras ni/ bskyed rim bsgom du rung ba'i nus pas rgyud 'gyur ba'i khyad par de yin la/ de nas bskyed rim bsgom pas 'bras bu de 'dra thob pa yin pas/ 'og min gyi rig 'dzin de yang dbang bdun gyi dngos 'brel min la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i 'bras bu yang min no/ /de bzhin du/ rdzogs rim bsgoms pa la brten nas sngags lam gyi tshogs sbyor gnyis thob pa de yang*/ mchog dbang 'og ma gsum gyi brgyud pa'i 'bras bu tsam du ni 'gyur yang*/ dngos 'bras dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu gnyis kar du mi 'gyur ro/ /des na dbang dang sa'i sbyor tshul ni/ dag bya dag byed kyi sbyor tshul yang min cing*/ rten 'brel bsgrig bya sgrig byed kyi rgyu 'bras tsam yin pas/ sa mtshams nges pa can du sbyor pa yang mi dgos so/ /dri ba lnga pa'i lan ni/ yi ge dkyil 'khor dang po ste/ /zhes pa la sogs pa a bhi dha na'i lung 'di/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor kho na'i dbye ba min/ bum dbang gang du bskur ba'i phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor la drug tu phye ba lags/ dang po lnga po la yang*/ rdul tshon ras bris sogs sna tshogs 'byung ba lags shing*/ drug pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ gzhal yas khang gi khang pa dngos su bslangs pa'am/ chu tshon gyis sa gzhi la bris nas lha so so'i gnas su dpa' bo dang dpa' mo dngos su 'god pa ste/ dper na/ dges rdor la mtshon na/ dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon nyid gtso bo'i gnas su 'dug /gzhan sngags kyi spyod pa can gyi bud med dgu yang lha mo dgu'i gnas su bzhag

lha'i chas su bcug nas/ bdag bskyed gtso bor gyur pa'i chogs 'khor gyi tshogs dkyil 'khor sgrub pa yin pas/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin no/ /dri ba drug pa'i lan ni/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du ma smin pa smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba'i khungs/ shin tu gsal bar yod pa ni/ mi g.yo ba rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud na yod/ rgyud de yang thog mar rong pa shes rab seng ges bskul nas/ yar klungs lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba yin cing*/ 'gyur byed sa yang sa skya rang yin/ phyis paṇḍi ta nags rin gyi bar du lo paṇa gzhan dang gzhan 'ga' res 'gyur bcos cung zad tsam byas 'dug rgyud de las dang por rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri tshul rgyas par bshad nas/ de rjes/ yang na dkyil 'khor bri bya ba/ /ras bris tshul du bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor sngar bzhin bris byas nas/ /dbus su mi g.yo mthing nag bri/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ras bris rgyas par gsungs nas/ de dang 'brel ba nyid du/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi cho ga rgyas par bshad do/ /sdom gsum rab dbye mdzad pa po chos rje paṇḍi ta'i dus na rgyud 'di ma 'gyur bas lan ni/ gzhan gyi smin byed rgyud las bkag /ces gsungs thal po can du byon gda' 'on kyang rab dbye la sdang shugs byed pa po phyis 'byung gi bka' brgyud pa rnams kyis/ rgyud 'di la gzhig 'grel chug pa'ang med la/ rdul tshon la sdang ba bzhin ras bris la la'ang sdang bas/ khong dag lung 'di la dga' ba yang med do/ /der ma zad/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du ma smin pa smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba'i khungs kyang 'ga' zhig tu snang ngo*/ / dri ba bdun pa'i lan ni/ dbang bskur ba'i don dri ma 'khrud pa la shin tu 'jog /dbang ni ye shes ma skyes kyang*/ slob dpon gnyis char gyi sems ma yengs par sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum 'dzoms pa'i dbang chog byas na dri ma 'khrud pa'i tha snyad thob ste/

sngags kyi sdom pa thob pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na/ dge slong gi sdom pa thob pa'i rgyu tshogs tshang ba la/ gsol gzhi'i las kyi cho ga byas na/ sgom stobs kyi ye shes ma skyes kyang tshul 'chal gyi rgyun spong ba'i gnas skabs thob ste/ de'i gnyen po dge slong gi sdom pa skye ba'i phyir ro/ /de dang 'di 'dra lags/ kun rdzob brdar btags pa'i tshogs/ kun rdzob kyi sdom pa thob nus pa yin/ dbang gi ye shes skyes na yang*/ ye shes de la phyag chen yin min gnyis ka yod/ rab dbye las/ nged kyi phyag rgya chen po 'di/ /dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang*/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ni/ dngos dang rjes mthun pa'i phyag chen la dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang*/ rim gnyis gang rung las skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis tshur khyab mtha' 'cha' ba yin gyi/ dbang dang rim gnyis kyi ye shes la/ phyag chen kyis phar khyab mtha' 'cha' ba min/ dbang gi dri ma 'khrud pa ni/ dri ma 'khrud pa'i 'go brtsams pa yin gyi/ dri ma bkrus zin yang min pas/ ye shes dngos su skye bas kyang ma khyab bo/ kha cig dbang bskur tshad la ye shes skye ste/ dbang rnon la gsal bar skye/ dbang brtul la mi gsal bar skye/ zhes zer yang*/ ye shes de skye na snang du rung dgos pas/ mi gsal bar skye zhes pa'i zol 'jog de la/ snang rung ma dmigs pa'i gnod pa 'jug la/ lar byung ba'i rang byung ye shes yin ces pa lam 'bras kyi chos skad dang bstun dgos na/ gsang dbang gi ye shes yan chad rang byung gi ye shes yin pas/ dbang bskur bzhi pa ma thob par/ /phyag rgya chen po sogs sgom dang*/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal ba spang dgos so/ /dri ba brgyad pa'i lan ni/ las kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes kyang*/ dpe'i ye shes ni nges par yin/ chos rgya'i ye shes sogs dpe'i ye shes gzhan gyi rgyu byed kyang*/ kho rang dpe'i ye shes yin pa mi 'gal ste/

don gcig la mtshon byed kyi dpe du ma 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /lar las rgya'i ye shes las chos rgya 'byung*/ de las phyag rgya chen po 'byung*/ 'bras bu dam rgya yin ces bya ba 'di ni/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad zer ba'i phyag rgya bzhi pa'i gzhung dang*/ de'i rjes 'brang mai tri pa dpon slob rnams kho na'i bzhed pa yin no/ /gzhan phyag rgya bzhi la nā ro pa'i bde dgyes kyi man ngag dang*/ dril bu pa'i nor bu 'gengs pa sogs na mi 'dra ba re bshad pa/ thad so thad so der 'gal ba med/ phan tshun bsre mi thub/ dges rdor gyi 'grel pa kha che chen pos mdzad pa las kyang*/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya dus 'khor nas bshad pa dang mtshungs/ spyir las rgya ye rgya phyag chen gsum gyis zlas drangs pa'i las rgya dngos rig dang*/ ye rgya sgom pa'i rig ma la zer/ phyag rgya bzhi bgrod pa'i skabs/ dus 'khor las kyang ye rgya bgrang ba nyung zhing*/ gzhan rnams kyis ye rgya lar nas ma bgrangs te/ chos kyi phyag rgya bgrod pa yin/ las rgya'i ye shes de phyag rgya chen po dngos ma yin par nges/ rtogs pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba ni yod/ phyag chen rjes mthun pa'i dbang du byas na ni/ bskyed rim phyag chen dang*/ gtum mo phyag chen la sogs pa 'byung bas nges pa med kyang*/ phyag chen dngos la dbye na/ rnam bcas dang*/ rnam med gnyis yod/ dang po ni/ rtsa dbu mar 'bar 'dzag byas pa'i bde stong gi rigs gcig la/ bde stong de nyid la mnyam par bzhag pas/ rkyen gzhan med kyang slar gsar du rlung dbu mar 'gags te/ bde drod kyi nyams khyad par can skye ba zhig yod pa de la zer/ gnyis pa ni stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po yin no/ /las rgya'i ye shes ni las rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba kho na'i rkyen gyis zhu bde'i bde stong tsam 'dren pa yin pas/ bde stong spros bral kho na la mnyam par bzhag pas gsar du bde stong drangs pa dang*/

las rgyas drangs pa'i bde stong gnyis po shin tu khyad che'o/ /mai tri pa rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa dam brgya'i ngos 'dzin gtum mo la mi byed/ 'bras bu zung 'jug gi sku la byed pa yin pas/ de'i lugs kyi dam rgya ni so so skye bo'i gnas skabs na med/ nā ro sogs dam rgya gtum mo la byed pa'i lugs ltar na/ dam rgya ye shes mtshan nyid pa sbyor lam drod nas yod do/ /'di dag la mtha' chod pa zhig rgyas par bshad dgos na'ang/ yi ge'i tshogs la 'dzems pa dang gsang ba zab mor song bas/ 'phrin yig tu mdor bsdus tsam las ma brjod do/ /dri ba dgu pa'i lan ni/ stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po bya ba/ stong gzugs las grub pa'i lha sku yab yum kha sbyor gyi ming yin/ de tsam gyis kyang mi chog khyad chos gsum po 'di tshang dgos/ dbu ma'i nang du rtsal rdzogs pa'i gtum mo las grub pa gcig shes pa kho na yin kyang rnal 'byor pa'i lus kyi bya ba byed pas 'dod chags chen po'i bde ba myos nus pa dang gnyis/ khyad gzhi lha sku de la khyad chos 'khor 'das kyi gzugs brnyan thams cad gcig car 'char ba dang gsum mo/ /'di so so skye bo'i gnas skabs na ni yod de/ yan lag drug gi rjes dran gyi rim pa'i skabs nas 'byung ngo*/ /dri ba bcu pa'i lan ni/ nyin rtags drug gi ngos 'dzin rgyas pa ni/ snyan brgyud bka' rgya can lags pas 'dir 'bri ma nus/ ngo bo ni thig le ser po dang*/ dkar po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ nag po'i snang ba rnams la ser po 'bar ba sogs bzhi dang*/ mchog gi cha 'od 'khyug pa dang*/ thig le zhes pa thig le sngon po yin/ 'di rnams shar ba tsam sor bsdud mthar phyin pa na 'byung bas/ sbyor lam drod kyi sgrub pa la zhugs pa'i skabs nas yod la/ rjes mthun pa ni las dang po pa nas kyang yod do/ /yan lag drug po thams cad la rtags bcu rnams gong 'phel du 'gro bas/ so so la yang 'char lugs mi gcig pa'i khyad par shin tu che ba yin/

stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po de yang rtags bcu'i rang bzhin du gnas pa yin lags/ dri ba bcu gcig pa ni/ phyag rgya bzhi'i nang tshan gyi phyag rgya chen po la/ rtogs bya yul gyi phyag chen de don gyi ye shes yin yang*/ rtogs byed lam gyi phyag chen la don gyi ye shes yin pas ma khyab ste/ 'di la gnyis snang gi cha shas dngos su spong ba nas brtsams te/ lam gyi phyag chen dngos yin yang*/ da dung rdzogs par spangs ma zin pa'i bar du mnyam gzhag dang gnyis snang gzhan 'dre bas/ don gyi ye shes dngos ma yin/ mnyam gzhag tu gnyis snang mtha' dag 'gags pa'i tshe/ yul yul can dbye ba med pa'i phyir don gyi ye shes dngos yin pas/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang po thob pa nas bzung*/ dus 'khor lugs la phyag rgya gsum gyi zlas drangs pa'i phyag chen gyi ye shes dngos skyes pa yin/ don gyi ye shes kyi cha shas kyang thob pa yin mod/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i skad cig rdzogs pa na don gyi ye shes kyang rdzogs pas/ don gyi ye shes thob pa'i sa mtshams ni rdzogs par thob pa la 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i sa dang po nyid yin/ des na don gyi phyag chen rdzogs pa dang*/ mi 'gyur pa'i bde ba rdzogs pa ni ngo bo gcig go /spyir phyag chen tsam ni/ sbyor ba yan lag drug ka yin te/ ji skad du/ so so bsdud pa phyag rgya che/ /nam mkha' stong pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pas shes so/ /lar mi 'gyur pa'i bde ba'i ngos 'dzin thun mong ma yin pa nges tig can cig gi ni phyis lho byang khri skor gyi dus 'khor ba ci 'dra zhig gi yang*/ thugs dang zhal gnyis can la 'dug pa ma mthong*/ rtsa rlung gi nus pa cung zad tsam yod par rlom pa 'ga' zhig la/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba brnyes so zhes slob ma rnams sgrog par gda' ste/ zhu bde 'gyur med dang mi 'gyur pa'i bde ba gnyis dbye ba ma phyed pa'i cal col du 'dug

yang bka' brgyud pa rnams gnas lugs phyag chen gyi dbang du byas nas/ sems kyi rang bzhin gnas skabs mi 'gyur bar shes pa tsam la/ dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde bar ngos 'dzin te/ gser dang ra gan nor ba lags so/ /gnas lugs phyag chen la ni/ phyag chen gyi sgra bshad du yod pa dang*/ mtshan nyid phyogs mthun tsam yod srid kyang rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i phyag chen gyi mtshan nyid ma tshang ngo*/ /dri ba bcu gnyis pa'i lan ni/ spyir dga' bzhi'i ye shes tsam rgyu'i dbang bskur ba'i dus rang na yod/ yang dbang las byung ba'i ye shes yin kyang*/ dbang bskur ba'i dus rang du skye dgos pa rang gis kyang ma khyab/ skad cig ma'i dga' bzhi ni gzhi dus nas kyang yod pas/ nam skye nges pa med cing*/ de'i ye shes tsam bskyed rdzogs kyi skabs kyang thams cad du 'byung ngo*/ /sa lam gyis bsdus pa'i dga' bzhi bya ba cig yod pa/ tshogs lam gyi skabs na ni med de/ lam der rdzogs rim gyis sa ma thob pa'i phyir ro/ /sbyor lam drod rtse gnyis yas babs kyi dga' bzhi'i sas bsdus shing*/ bzod mchog gnyis mas brtan gyi dga' bzhis sas bsdus so/ /dri ba bcu gsum pa'i lan ni/ rig 'dzin zhes pa/ spyir don mang po la 'jug kyang gtso cher rig sngags dang*/ rig sngags kyi lha 'dzin pa la byed na/ rdzas kyi rig pa 'dzin pa bya ba/ ril lu sogs grub pa brgyad lta bu yin cing*/ longs spyod kyi rig pa 'dzin pa ni/ sngags kyi mthu las sgrub pa po rang snang du 'khor los sgyur pa'i longs spyod sogs thob pa cig yong bas/ de lta bu la zer/ de dag kyang mi'i rten ni gnas gyur nas 'gro ba yin pas/ mi'i 'gro ba dngos ni min/ lus kyi rig pa 'dzin pa ni gnyis te/ lus 'dod khams kyi rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ lus gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dang po ni bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa cig gis spros bcas spros med gang rung gi spyod pa spyad pas/

lus 'di nyid ma spangs par gnas gyur nas/ 'dod khams kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam pa'i 'ja' lus su gyur pa'o/ /snga ma gnyis dang 'di ste gsum kar spyir 'dod khams kyi rig 'dzin yin no/ /gnyis pa ni dbang po rno na/ bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa des/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa spyad pas/ mi lus gnas gyur pa yang yod la/ dbang po rtul na 'dod khams kyi rig pa 'dzin pa sgrub pa'i rjes su/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa spyad pas/ 'dod khams kyi lus de gnas gyur nas 'gro ste/ gang ltar yang gzugs khams kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam pa'i 'ja' lus su gyur pa'o/ /des na 'og min gyi srid pa 'grub pa tsam la 'og min gyi rig 'dzin du mi 'jog la/ 'og min gyi dngos grub tu yang mi 'jog go /de la dngos grub tu 'gyur ba la/ lha dang sngags kyi nus pas sgrubs pa zhig dgos shing*/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i tha snyad kyang*/ sngags kyi sgrub pa'i don dang*/ khyad par lus kyi rig 'dzin grub pa la/ sgrub pa po ma shi gong gi tshe 'di nyid la de dang de 'grub pa dgos kyi/ tshe 'phos te skye ba phyi ma der skyes pas go mi chod do/ /spyir rig 'dzin dang*/ rig sngags 'chang ba 'gyur khyad ma gtogs don gcig dper na da lta'i mi phal pa rnams bzla ba'i yi ge drug pa 'di/ rig sngags kyi gzugs brnyan yin gyi/ rig sngags dngos ma yin pas/ mi de dag rig sngags 'chang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas yig drug de shin tu bsgoms pas/ gsal snang mthar phyin pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnyed cing*/ de nyid bzlas pas nus pa 'grub ste/ de'i cho ga brtsam pa tsam gyis las dang dngos grub de dag 'bad pa med par 'grub rung du song ba na mi de'i rgyud kyi yig drug de rig sngags 'chang dngos su song ba yin pas/ mi de yang rig 'dzin nam rig sngags 'chang ba zhes bya/ de da ltar dngos grub ma thob kyang*/

des bsgrub na dngos grub de dag 'phral du 'grub la/ dngos grub 'grub na dngos 'grub de la rig pa 'dzin pa'i dngos grub ces bya zhing*/ gang zag de yang grub pa thob pa'o/ /rig 'dzin dang sngags 'chang de 'dra la zer/ dri yig 'di na 'og min gyi srid pa phyi rol pas 'grub pa yod pas so/ /gsung ba zhig 'dug ste/ gzugs khams kyi srid pa zhes gsungs rgyu la yi ge nor pa yin las che/ theg pa spyi'i lugs la 'og min gnas gtsang ma yin pas 'phags pa phyir mi 'ong gi nang tshan bsam gtan spel sgom byas pa rnams kho na der skye ba mngon pa las bshad pas/ phyi rol pa der skye ba mi srid cing*/ dus 'khor las zad par bsgoms pas gzugs khams gzugs med nyi shur skye ba zhig bshad de/ don ni spyi dang mthun la/ sngags kyi dngos grub 'di lta bu 'grub pa'ang phyi rol pa la med de spyir phyi rol pas snyoms 'jug pa'am/ grub mthas blo kha ma bsgyur yang chos nyid kyis thob pa'i gzugs khams gzugs med du skye ba yod kyang*/ phyi rol pa'i sngags la brten pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'dod khams kho na'i yin gyi/ gzugs khams kyi med do/ /'dod gzugs kyi lha'i rigs 'di dag rnams/ las kyi dbang gis der skyes pa'i lha rnams dang mi 'dra ste/ de'i phyir skal pa mnyam pa zhes pa'i tshig sbyor dgos so/ /dri ba bcu bzhi pa'i lan ni/ rtsa ltung lnga po dus kyi 'khor lo las/ kunda byang sems spong bar bshad pa gsal kha can yin cing*/ rgyud gzhan rnams las byang chub kyi sems spong ba zhes pa ma gtogs byang sems la ngos 'dzin gsal kha med/ rgyud kyi don 'chad pa'i rgya bod kyi bla ma rnams kyis mi 'dra ba sna tshogs bshad/ bla ma rje btsun chen pos rtsa ltung 'khrul spong du/ kunda byang sems spong ba tsam la rtsa ltung du 'dod pa phyogs sngar mdzad nas dgag pa dngos su mdzad gda' ba la/

bar skabs su byung ba'i mkhas pa mang pos/ 'gog byed dang*/ sgrub byed mang po mdzad gda'/ rtsa ltung gzhan rnams kyi skabs su dus 'khor gyi lung re drangs shing*/ lnga pa'i skabs 'dir ma drangs pas/ dus 'khor la dgag pa yin snyam pa dge bshes phal cher la byung gda'/ gsung de phyir re mda' pas/ 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yang*/ /dpyod ldan chen po 'ga' yis rnam par dpyad/ /ces chos spong gi sdig pa chen po gsog pa la ham pa skye ba'i rgyur yang song 'dug ste/ rje btsun chen pos dus 'khor 'gog pa ni ye min te/ skabs gzhan thams cad du dus 'khor la mchog tu dges shing lung mang du 'dren pa'i phyir ro/ /shugs la dgag par song snyam yang ma song ste/ dus 'khor gyi dgongs pa'ang phyogs snga ma de ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dbang po gnyis kyi bde ba don dam pa'i lam du 'dod pa'i log rtogs dang 'brel bas mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po sgrub pa'i lam la ma gus pas kun nas slang ste/ kunda byang chub sems spang ba rtsa ltung du dgongs pa yin la/ dbang gsum pa'i dam tshig gi skabs su bshad pa rnams dang ni mi 'dra ste/ de skabs ni kun slong bsam pa'i khyad par de lta bu sbyor mi dgos par tshul de lta bus kunda spangs kyang*/ dbang de'i dam tshig gi nyes par 'gyur ba 'di yin no/ /spyir 'di dus 'khor du ma zad/ 'khor lo sdom pa nas gsung pa'i dam tshig brgyad kyi nang na yang yod pas/ rgyud gzhan gyi lugs kyi bum dbang gi dam tshig tu mi 'gyur ba yang ma yin no/ /rtsa ltung lnga pa rje btsun chen po'i rang lugs la/ smon sems spong ba la bshad cing*/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa'i gzhung la rtsa ltung 'grel chen sogs bshad pa byed pa'i lugs tha dad pa rnams dang bskrun na/ rje btsun chen po'i lugs de gzhan rnams las legs pa yin la/ dus 'khor pa rnams kyang*/ dus 'khor lugs ltar 'chad dgos pa gzhir bzhag na'ang/

spyi ldog nas lugs gnyis po gang legs zhe na/ dus 'khor ltar legs par mngon te/ smon 'jug gi byang sems rnams byams snying rje dang 'gro ldog gcig pas/ rtsa ltung gsum pa byams pa spangs pa tsam gyis de dag kyang spangs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dri ba bco lnga pa'i lan ni/ bskyed rim ni/ mchog sgrubs pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lam min par dam 'cha' dgos la/ bskyed rim nyid kho na bsgom pas 'phags pa'i sa bdun thob pa ni nam du yang mi 'dod do/ / dbang bdun dang sa bdun 'brel tshul ni gong du bshad pa ltar yin la/ 'phags pa'i sa dang po thob nas bskyed rim bsgom pa mi srid de/ des bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi lta bu'i dmigs pa'i rim pa sgom pa la gal te yod srid kyang*/ rdzogs rim gyi nang nas kyang*/ zung 'jug kho na yin gyi/ bskyed rim min no/ /de'i phyir bskyed rim rkyang pa sgom pa lta zhog rdzogs rim dang 'dris te sgom pa yang de yan chad du mi srid de/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs dgongs pa gtod tshul ci 'dra zhig mdzad kyang*/ rnam rtog 'byung ba mi srid pa bzhin no/ /'phags pa min yang rdzogs rim gyi ye shes la brtan pa thob na/ drag shul sbyor ba sogs dgos pa'i khyad par 'ga' zhig la/ bskyed rim cung zad sgom pa srid kyang*/ phal cher mi sgom ste/ dgos pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dbang bdun gyi 'phags pa'i sa de dang de thob pa'i rten 'brel sgrig kyang*/ des de dag thob par byed mi dgos te/ dper na lha'i mngon rtogs kyi 'gor ye shes tshogs bsog bsgom pas chos sku thob pa'i rten 'brel sgrig kyang*/ de tsam gyis chos sku thob par mi 'gyur zhing*/ chos sku thob la khad pa'i skabs su de 'dra sgom yang mi dgos pa bzhin no/ /des na dbang bdun bskyed rim dang bcas pa ni/ sa bdun thob pa'i ring rgyu tsam byed kyang*/ dngos rgyu byed pa mi srid cing*/

rgyud pa'i rgyu la yang 'di rnams med kyang*/ thabs gzhan gyis sa bdun po sgrub tu yod pa'i phyir/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu yang ma yin la/ med na mi 'byung gi rgyu yang min no/ /'di ni dus 'khor ba'i chos skad du ma zad/ rtsa ba'i grub mthar dam 'cha' ba lags/ yang las dang po pa la de dag mi dgos zer ba ni/ ye ma lags/ dbang po rnon po kha cig ma gtogs phal cher la gal yang shin tu che ba yin la/ rang re yang de dag la 'bad rtsol byed par mos pa yin mod kyi/ dngos po'i mtshan nyid dang chos nas bshad tshul la mi lta bar/ rang la mkho ba de mchog tu sgrub cing*/ mi mkho ba rnams la brnyas se byed pa de/ blun po'am g.yo can gyi rnam thar yin pas/ ring du spang pa lags so/ /spyir bla ma re la grub mtha' re'i dpe yin pas/ 'di ni bden gyi gzhan ni gti mug go zhes mi zer yang*/ bdag cag nyid kyi sems la rnam rtog gting tshugs pa'i grub mtha' thun mong ma yin pa mang po bdog cing*/ khyad par du sngags kyi lam rim la/ bod rnams kyi zer sgros phal cher yang khong du chud mod/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang ngam/ he ru ka dngos rgya gar gyi grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i lugs srol la yid brtan 'cha' ba yin gyi/ dpe nyog zer sgros bsdu mkhan zhig ma lags so/ /dri lan mdo tsam sbyar ba 'di/ /thugs la 'phrod par smon pa lags/ /slar yang chos dang ldan pa yi/ /gleng slang 'di 'dra gong 'phel shog /bo dong bya rgod gshongs kyi 'chad nyan mdzad pa klu sgrub sku skye drung gi dri lan/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o// //zhus so/ /bkra shis/
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/zab mo sngags kyi dri lan sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 176 -- PAGE 175 - - PAGE 156 -
